body:
THE MAP, THE ORDER AND THE GUARD (api.py read 6 Nov 2026, main e394d03; 1,500 lines, 57 routes under one `APIRouter`).

ORDER: do P3-29 part 1 first (the held lock fix, branch `held/server-db-lock`, +82/-31 in this very file; it merges cleanly today, see the P3-29 note). A split first turns its hunks into a hand rebase. #131 (lyrics, held) also needs a rebase after any move.

THE GUARD GOES FIRST: docs/17 section 3 used to say a script compares its table with the registered routes; none exists (register B-68). Land `tests/test_contract_routes.py` BEFORE the first route moves: read the Built column of docs/17 section 3 and `app.routes`, fail on a difference either way (57 and 57 today). The route set is the only thing the split must not change.

THE SECTIONS AS THE FILE HAS THEM (line numbers on e394d03): shared (Services 84, `services` 108, Principal and `get_principal` 112-220, `_ok` 220) -> deps; "the routes" 224-426 (info, server, auth, me, devices, notifications, invites, join) -> accounts; people 426-605; song refs 605-625; "the audio of a ref" 625-923 (the keep routes 625-740, stream-url, covers, `_stream_error` ~829, `stream`) -> keep and audio; the library 923-1041 (`want_kept` at 951 is shared by library, playlists and keep: its own module, with `keeper/triggers.py`); playlists 1041-1161; imports 1161-1198; playback 1198-1233; the live channel 1233-1280 (websocket); the application 1280-1500 (the scheduler wiring ~1300-1370, `create_app` 1370).

WHAT THE TESTS NEED FROM api.py: 17 imports of `create_app` and `api._default_tools` (a private helper in the application section) in the server tests. Keep both importable from `encore_server.api` and the move is invisible to them. Nothing else is imported by name, so the split is mechanically safe once the route test exists.

TRAPS: the single `router = APIRouter(prefix="/encore/api/v1")` (line 226) is included once in `create_app`; several routers must keep the prefix, and the order they are included in, because overlapping templates of the same method match first-come (check `invites/check` against `invites/{id}`, `people/{id}/reset` against `people/{person_id}`). The stream and cover routes are added with `add_api_route` outside the prefix (create_app ~1477), keep them outside. Middleware order (`InFlightMiddleware`, `BodyLimit`, and P1-19's request-id one) stays in `create_app`.

DONE WHEN: no file over about 500 lines, `create_app` alone in api.py, the route test green, docs/05 (the layout) updated. Size: the route test and P3-29 first make the move itself a half day.
